review_comments: I don't get this. This `Update()` override was added in [`a8764b6`](https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/18587/commits/a8764b67e1ac962cdbb78d97ddba6ab270167e78), which mentions "avoiding using invalidation" because it "triggers too often", but the `OnInvalidate()` override is still there just above? What's happening here? It looks like two methods of doing the same thing are being used here - would prefer sticking to just one if possible.

I think this one was supposed to replace the `OnInvalidate` override given that that keeps triggering as layers of the game change size from events like showing/hiding toolbar, but that's as far as I've seen and may be wrong.
oops, the invalidation pathway should have been removed. git fail.
